sources.title: rishanthrajendhran/ideadet-nemotron30b-1m-outline · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Training corpus: 1m Reads at inference: a de-leaked (paraphrased) role-labelled outline of the document Scored by comparing the next-token log-probabilities of the tokens human and ai, two-way normalised, giving P (human). The detector fires when that falls below a calibrated threshold.
